dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします★
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I'm looking forward to our session.★

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, it's a pleasure to meet you. I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.content: はいこんにちは★
dialogue.English: Yes, hello.★

dialogue.content: はい(^o^)
dialogue.English: Yes. (^o^)

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、大丈夫でしたら、スータートしても構わないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but if you're okay with it, shall we get started?

dialogue.content: いいですよ★
dialogue.English: That's fine.★

dialogue.content: ではお願いします。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's begin. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 学校の寮生活について色々悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I’m struggling with various things about life in my school dorm.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、学生寮の生活でお悩みなんですね。どのような事でお悩みかお聞かせ願えますか？
dialogue.English: I see, you’re having difficulties with life in the student dorm. Could you tell me more about what’s troubling you?

dialogue.content: 先輩が怖くて・・・
dialogue.English: I’m scared of the upperclassmen...

dialogue.content: 慣れない学生寮で不安の中、先輩が怖いのは辛いですよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be tough to be scared of the upperclassmen, especially when you're still getting used to the dorm and feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: はい。なんか想像を絶するというか。やばいです
dialogue.English: Yes. It's beyond imagination, you could say. It's really bad.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。想像を絶すると聞くと恐怖をかんじてしまいますが、どのような事があるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Hearing that it's "beyond imagination" sounds terrifying. What kinds of things are happening?

dialogue.content: 新入生歓迎会期間があったのですが、入学前から朝5時半に起こされて。
dialogue.English: There was a welcome period for new students, but even before school officially started, they would wake us up at 5:30 in the morning.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 端から端まで雑巾がけをやらされるんです。
dialogue.English: They make us wipe the floors from end to end with a rag.

dialogue.content: 目に止まった生徒には蹴りや、立たされて胸ぐら掴まれて罵声が飛びます
dialogue.English: Any student who catches their eye gets kicked, is forced to stand, grabbed by the collar, and yelled at.

dialogue.content: 木刀や金属バットを持って立っている先輩もいます
dialogue.English: There are also upperclassmen standing around holding wooden swords and metal bats.

dialogue.content: ええ！！それは想像を絶してしまうほどですね
dialogue.English: Oh my! That truly is beyond imagination.

dialogue.content: はい。次は自分かと思いながらなんとかやり過ごしました。
dialogue.English: Yes. I managed to get through it, all the while thinking I would be next.

dialogue.content: 相談者様はなんとかやり過ごされたのですか？
dialogue.English: So you managed to get through it somehow?

dialogue.content: ぇえ。なんとか・・自分は怒鳴られるくらいですみました。
dialogue.English: Yeah. Somehow... I got off with just being yelled at.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・とは言え、とても見ていてお辛いですよね・・
dialogue.English: I see... Even so, it must have been very painful to witness.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、学生寮とは、大学生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when you say student dorm, is it for university students?

dialogue.content: 自己紹介の練習を雑巾がけのあとにするんですが、その時は決まった姿勢をキープできず。壁に追いやられ壁を殴って・・自分の顔を先輩のパンチがかめました。そのあと殺すぞって言われました
dialogue.English: After we wipe the floors, we practice self-introductions, but I couldn’t hold the required posture. I was pushed against the wall, and they started punching it... a senior’s punch grazed my face. After that, they told me, “I’ll kill you.”

dialogue.content: 高1から入る5年制の学校です。卒業すれば短大までの卒業歴になります
dialogue.English: It's a five-year school that you enter from the first year of high school. When you graduate, it's equivalent to graduating from a junior college.

dialogue.content: ５年制、そうなんですね。とても厳しいとは言っても、暴力が半端ない感じに思えます
dialogue.English: A five-year program, I see. Even if it's supposed to be strict, the level of violence seems extreme.

dialogue.content: ぇえ。面白いことしろとOBが来て言われて、キンチョールを股間にかけるよう強要された事もあります
dialogue.English: Yeah. An alumnus came and told us to do something funny, and I was forced to spray insecticide (Kincho) on my crotch.

dialogue.content: ふざけて楽しいを超えていると感じますが、よく耐えていらっしゃります・・失礼ですが男子寮？なのですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds like it goes far beyond joking around for fun. You've been enduring so much... Forgive me for asking, but is this a men's dormitory?

dialogue.content: あーそうです男です。男子寮です。
dialogue.English: Ah, yes, I’m a guy. It’s a boys’ dorm.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・その時はご自分の股間に仕方なくされたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... At that time, did you have no choice but to spray your own crotch?

dialogue.content: はい。大丈夫か？って言われて大丈夫ですって言ったらそりゃ大丈夫だろ。皮かぶってんだから。ちゃんと出してやれって
dialogue.English: Yes. They asked, "Are you okay?" and when I said I was fine, they said, "Of course you're fine. You're uncircumcised. Pull it back and do it right."

dialogue.content: やったあとはすぐ洗に行かせてくれましたが
dialogue.English: They let me go wash it off right after I did it, though.

dialogue.content: どうにかならなくて良かったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad nothing serious happened.

dialogue.content: ええ、本当にそう思います。よく耐えていらっしゃりますよね。相談者さんは、そんな暴力を受けて、どう感じておられますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I truly think so. You've endured so much. Having experienced such violence, how do you feel?

dialogue.content: 歓迎期間の後は毎日ではなく気まぐれで先輩達はやってきます。いつそうなるか、分からなくて怖いです
dialogue.English: After the welcome period, the upperclassmen don't come every day, but just whenever they feel like it. I'm scared because I never know when it's going to happen.

dialogue.content: ええ、怖いですよね・・。先輩たちが来られた時だけなんですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that must be terrifying... So it only happens when the upperclassmen show up.

dialogue.content: １年はみんな被害者なので、先輩達だけ怖いです。
dialogue.English: All the first-years are victims, so it's only the upperclassmen who are scary.

dialogue.content: １年間は基本談話室で１年８人くらいで過ごします
dialogue.English: For the first year, the eight of us first-years basically spend all our time in the common room.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: キンチョールもその談話室での出来事でした
dialogue.English: The insecticide incident also happened in that common room.

dialogue.content: 一年生が基本、的になってるんでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: So the first-years are basically the targets?

dialogue.content: そうですね。２年は１年の管理係です
dialogue.English: That's right. The second-years are in charge of managing the first-years.

dialogue.content: 管理係なんですね、役割があるんですね。管理とは、監視とはまた違うのですか？
dialogue.English: In charge of managing... so they have a role. Is "managing" different from "monitoring"?

dialogue.content: 似たようなものです。１年の１年間の振る舞い方を教える感じです
dialogue.English: They're similar. It's like they teach the first-years how to behave for the entire year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。色々上下関係もありつつ、て感じが伺えますが、２年生は暴力的な事は免れていくのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like there’s a strict hierarchy. Do the second-year students get to avoid the violence?

dialogue.content: まぁ２年がやられる時はよっぽど２年が先輩に対し悪い事をしたときだけです。基本自由にやっているように見えます
dialogue.English: Well, second-years only get targeted if they do something really bad to the upperclassmen. For the most part, they seem free to do as they please.

dialogue.content: ただ２年も先輩の命令は絶対です。
dialogue.English: But for the second-years too, orders from the upperclassmen are absolute.

dialogue.content: 先輩も基本は１年に命令しますが
dialogue.English: The upperclassmen usually give orders to the first-years, though.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。２年になったら呼吸が出来るんだなと少しホッとしましたが、先輩の命令は従った上でなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. I was a little relieved to think you can breathe easier as a second-year, but that's still on the condition that you obey the upperclassmen's orders.

dialogue.content: とても怖い思いをしながらの学生生活はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How is your school life, living with so much fear?

dialogue.content: ２年の役割は１年の管理ですから、目の付けられた１年を呼んで来いとかそこらへんの命令が多いですね
dialogue.English: The second-years' role is to manage the first-years, so they mostly get orders like, "Go get that first-year who's been targeted."

dialogue.content: 正直怖いです。
dialogue.English: Honestly, I’m scared.

dialogue.content: ええ、支配下の元ですね
dialogue.English: Yes, you're completely under their control.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怖いですよね。先生は寮生活とは関与されないのですか？
dialogue.English: It must be frightening. Are the teachers not involved in dorm life?

dialogue.content: そういう風潮のようです。むしろ緩和されていると優しくしている方だと先輩に言われました。だから先生も大事にならない限り関与はしません
dialogue.English: That seems to be the culture here. The upperclassmen told me that it's actually gotten milder and that they're being nice to us. So the teachers don't get involved unless something major happens.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。元々の風潮でスパルタ系ではあるという事なんでしょうが、大きくはしてないけど中では度を越しているとお感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So the school has a spartan culture to begin with, but do you feel that while they keep it from becoming a big public issue, what's happening inside has gone too far?

dialogue.content: 自分からすればこんな経験初めてなので。ただ先生がその事実をどこまで知っているかは分かりません。僕は先生にチクったりは出来ません
dialogue.English: For me, this is the first time I've ever experienced anything like this. I don't know how much the teachers know about it. I can't snitch on them to the teachers.

dialogue.content: はい、勿論出来ない気持ち痛いほど伝わります。ただただ怖いですものね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can keenly feel why you can't do that. It's just too scary, isn't it.

dialogue.content: ぇえ。
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 初めての体験で、友達や仲間が暴力うけていたら今度は自分もって思うし、萎縮してしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It's your first time experiencing this, and when you see your friends and peers being subjected to violence, you must feel like you'll be next, and that makes you shrink away in fear.

dialogue.content: 友達は飲み会の時は肛門にプラスチックハンガーを折った先を入れられていました。。僕達は見てることしか出来ませんでした。
dialogue.English: At a drinking party, a friend of mine had the broken tip of a plastic hanger inserted into his anus... All we could do was watch.

dialogue.content: ・・・何とも辛い・・
dialogue.English: ...How unbearably painful...

dialogue.content: お前らは何やるんだ？これじゃ俺らがこいつを虐めているみたいじゃないか？って
dialogue.English: They said, "What are you guys going to do? This just makes it look like we're the ones bullying him, doesn't it?"

dialogue.content: 逆にこちらに罪を・・って感じですね
dialogue.English: It feels like they're trying to shift the blame onto you.

dialogue.content: もう一人の先生がパイパンレンジャーを作ろうとか言って自分らは自ら陰部の毛を剃りました。
dialogue.English: Another upperclassman said something about making a "Paipan Ranger" team, so we had to shave our own pubic hair.

dialogue.content: 先生じゃなくて先輩です。
dialogue.English: Not a teacher, an upperclassman.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 怖いとかキツイを超えているように感じてしまいます
dialogue.English: It feels like this goes beyond scary or harsh.

dialogue.content: こんな寮生活普通じゃないと思うんですが。どこの学校の寮もこんななのかなー。
dialogue.English: I don't think this kind of dorm life is normal. I wonder if dorms at all schools are like this.

dialogue.content: あと半年。。。
dialogue.English: Just six more months...

dialogue.content: いえ、スパルタはあるかもですが、これは虐待の領域だと思います。
dialogue.English: No, while some places might be spartan, I believe this is in the realm of abuse.

dialogue.content: 頑張れるか。。
dialogue.English: I wonder if I can make it...

dialogue.content: 後、半年・・とお思いなんですね。
dialogue.English: Another six months... that's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: 怖いこと言わないで下さい。
dialogue.English: Please don't say scary things.

dialogue.content: ２年になればきっと大丈夫ですよね？
dialogue.English: It'll be okay once I'm a second-year, right?

dialogue.content: 失礼しました。本当に心配しておりますがゆえ。後半年と、言われた言葉で、相談者さんが楽になれる見込みがあるとお思いならば、こちらもそう信じたいとおもったのですが。
dialogue.English: I apologize. It's only because I'm truly worried. When you said "another six months," I felt that if you believe there's a prospect of things getting easier, then I wanted to believe that too.

dialogue.content: 僕もそう思いたいです。
dialogue.English: I want to believe that too.

dialogue.content: ２年生の先輩方が頑張ってこの寮生活を続けていらっしゃるのならば・・と思うのですが、先輩とお話しできたらと・・
dialogue.English: I'm thinking that if the second-year students are managing to endure this dorm life... perhaps it would help if you could talk with one of them...

dialogue.content: ２年の先輩とお話しできそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a second-year senior you feel you could talk to?

dialogue.content: ２年生とは話したりは、ありますよ。
dialogue.English: I do talk with the second-years sometimes.

dialogue.content: 希望が欲しいなと思うので・・
dialogue.English: Because I think it would be good to have some hope...

dialogue.content: 髪は２年生から染めても大丈夫だと２年生で染めている人もいます。
dialogue.English: Some second-years dye their hair; they say it's okay to do it starting from the second year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、相談者さんも染めたいですか？少しは自由になりたいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Would you like to dye your hair too? You'd like to have a little freedom, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: まぁ今は目立ちたくないですけどね。
dialogue.English: Well, I don’t want to stand out right now.

dialogue.content: 今は目をつけられたら困りますものね。こんな怖いけどこの学校の魅力は何だと思われますか？
dialogue.English: You're right, it would be bad to be targeted now. I know it's so scary, but what do you think is the appeal of this school?

dialogue.content: 魅力というよりは退学したら親に迷惑かけるので。
dialogue.English: It's less about its appeal and more about the fact that I would cause trouble for my mother if I dropped out.

dialogue.content: 母子家庭で。お金もあまりありません。
dialogue.English: I come from a single-mother household, and we don’t have much money.

dialogue.content: 今更転校はお金もかかるし
dialogue.English: And transferring schools at this point would cost money.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母さんの想いを背負っていらっしゃるから、お金の問題も考えて、乗り越える事を考えておられるんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. So perhaps because you're carrying your mother’s hopes and also considering the financial issues, you’re trying to find a way to get through this?

dialogue.content: 凄く強い気持ちがあったんですね
dialogue.English: You have such a strong resolve.

dialogue.content: そのつもりでしたが、やばくないですか？この寮。
dialogue.English: That was my intention, but... isn't this dorm insane?

dialogue.content: はい、正直、暴行を通り越さないか心配です。失礼ながら私が、母ならば、笑っていて欲しいので・・
dialogue.English: Yes, honestly, I’m worried it could cross the line into outright assault. Forgive me for saying so, but if I were your mother, I would want you to be happy and smiling...

dialogue.content: あーぁ。
dialogue.English: Ah...

dialogue.content: 相談者さんの身を案じて楽しく過ごすためにを考えたいと思いましたら、時間となってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I wanted to think more about how you can stay safe and have a more enjoyable time, but it seems we're out of time.

dialogue.content: 家の親もそういうタイプですけど、、
dialogue.English: My mother is that type too, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いやいや1時間ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, no, thank you for the hour.

dialogue.content: お互いが想いあってる親子さんなのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you and your mother care deeply for each other.

dialogue.content: もっとどうしていったらいいかお聞きしたかったですが、時間なのでこの辺で
dialogue.English: I wanted to ask more about what we should do from here, but since we're out of time, we'll have to end here for today.

dialogue.content: 親には余計な事は言わないですけどね。
dialogue.English: I don't tell my mother anything that would worry her, though.

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした(^o^)
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time. (^o^)

dialogue.content: そうなんでしょうね、優しいお方です。先ずは、命をお守りくださいね。お母さまの為にも、命、、、。すみません、余計怖いですよね。またいらしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure you don't. You're a very kind person. First and foremost, please protect your life. For your mother's sake, as well... your life... I’m sorry, that must sound even scarier. Please do come back again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい。お疲れ様でした★
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you for your time.★
